meta.title: Performance optimization: Reduce string allocations in indexing system
meta.body_summary: Change SecondaryIndex::insert() to accept &str instead of String to reduce heap allocations by ~30-50% and improve write throughput ~10-15%, along with a performance optimization report.

perf_labels.notes: Devin changed SecondaryIndex::insert signature to &str, reducing allocations; merged without formal review after CI fixes, but maintainer later noted work incomplete.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2759 changed lines, this is a large edit by absolute volume, but most churn comes from merging main branch (Cargo.lock, RocksDB removal). The core indexing optimization in src/index.rs is about 125 lines. Merged without formal review in under 3 hours, fitting a small-step performance change that passed CI.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer MarcusSorealheis commented after merge that 'Devin mostly did not complete it work', indicating dissatisfaction but not blocking merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce heap allocations by ~30-50% and improve write throughput ~10-15% by accepting &str instead of String in SecondaryIndex::insert().
review_details.antipattern_addressed: unnecessary_string_allocation (prior pattern of passing owned Strings)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Rust allocation optimization via signature change was within Devin's capability; PR merged rapidly despite later maintainer comment about incomplete work, suggesting minimal barrier when CI passes.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-reading review prior to merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data provided; PR body claims numeric impact but author admitted inability to test locally due to missing libclang.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regression identified; CI formatting and compilation issues were fixed within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Changed SecondaryIndex::insert() to accept &str instead of String, moving .to_string() calls to inside insert only when storing in HashSet/BTreeMap; updated all call sites and tests; added PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn comes from merging main branch to remove RocksDB support; Cargo.lock and backend files account for majority of changes.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: signature change, test updates, add performance report.
Fix call sites in example and integration test to use &str.
Fix formatting in main.rs, interop.rs, integration main.rs.
Merge origin/main resolving conflicts to remove RocksDB support.
Fix compilation errors in unique constraint checks within insert().
